The '''Salus Corporation''' was an arms manufacturer based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] that marketed to [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. The company was well known for its [[Stalker Armor M1-10]] and [[Tangler Elite 1]] [[tangle gun]], but the company also supplemented innovation with corporate espionage. Its [[DF-D1 Duo-Flechette Rifle/Legends|DF-D1 Duo-Flechette Rifle]] was based on stolen designs of the [[Golan Arms/Legends|Golan Arms]] [[FC-1 flechette launcher/Legends|FC-1 flechette launcher]]. The company became a government-owned division of [[Imperial Munitions/Legends|Imperial Munitions]] after design flaws and fatal accidents with the DF-D1 came to light.
